section_title: Configure the asset, strategy, and horizon the engine should read
section_intro: The homepage does not invent a winner. It shows where cost tends to concentrate for the selected combination before the full ranking runs.
strategy_hint: Available strategies change according to asset and horizon.
strategy_note_opening_breakout: Intraday equity setup centered on execution speed.
strategy_note_mean_reversion: A strategy that is highly sensitive to small repeated frictions.
strategy_note_earnings_swing: A swing setup where carry and holding risk start to matter.
strategy_note_stock_picking: Position approach on single names where the wrapper changes real cost materially.
strategy_note_quality_compound: Accumulation or position style focused on compounding and reducing friction.
strategy_note_dividend_reinvest: Long-horizon approach where TER, tickets, and reinvestment matter over time.
strategy_note_sector_rotation: ETF rotation with selective turnover across execution and structural costs.
strategy_note_core_satellite: A mixed approach where portfolio structure matters more than any single trade.
strategy_note_macro_allocation: ETF allocation built around a macro view with a longer horizon.
strategy_note_pac_etf: An accumulation plan where recurring costs and TER become central.
strategy_note_session_breakout: Intraday FX approach where spread and fill quality dominate.
strategy_note_mean_reversion_fx: FX setup that requires tight control over spread and financing.
strategy_note_macro_swing: Currency swing trading where carry starts to weigh on results.
strategy_note_carry_trade: A position strategy where funding is part of the PnL, not a side detail.
strategy_note_trend_day: Intraday index trading where execution and rollover are decisive.
strategy_note_open_drive: An opening setup that amplifies every execution mistake.
strategy_note_breakout_pullback: Swing strategy balancing execution, holding, and structural cost.
strategy_note_macro_trend: Index position strategy with increasing holding impact.
capital_hint: Capital shifts the balance between percentage drag, recurring cost, and ticket cost.
score_note: Pre-ranking synthetic signal for the selected combination.
insight_intraday: In intraday trading, cost concentrates in execution because every point of friction repeats many times.
insight_swing: In swing trading, the clean separation disappears and execution starts to combine with carry.
insight_position: In position trading, wrapper choice and holding cost stop being minor details.
insight_accumulation: In long-term accumulation, the real risk is underestimating recurring costs and structure.
read_asset_equities: Equity asset: the engine compares cash, derivatives, and proxies according to strategy.
read_asset_etf: ETF asset: efficiency depends on TER, recurring orders, and the alternative direct instrument.
read_asset_forex: Forex asset: spread, financing, and trading session radically change the profile.
read_asset_indices: Index asset: execution quality and funding matter more than most people expect.
read_horizon_intraday: Short holding window: the engine prioritizes execution drag and turnover.
read_horizon_swing: Intermediate holding window: execution and carry begin to stack together.
read_horizon_position: Extended holding window: holding cost becomes a decision variable.
read_horizon_accumulation: Long horizon: the engine gives more weight to recurring cost and structure.
read_strategy_opening_breakout: Opening momentum strategy: every out-of-line spread compounds quickly.
read_strategy_mean_reversion: Mean reversion: even small frictions can alter the expected average edge.
read_strategy_earnings_swing: Earnings swing: holding cost can matter as much as the setup itself.
read_strategy_stock_picking: Stock picking: wrapper choice can matter almost as much as the selected name.
read_strategy_quality_compound: Quality compound: recurring costs and unnecessary frictions erode compounding.
read_strategy_dividend_reinvest: Dividend reinvest: TER, commissions, and reinvestment mechanics matter over long horizons.
read_strategy_sector_rotation: Sector rotation: selective turnover makes both execution and structure important.
read_strategy_core_satellite: Core satellite: cost changes between the core sleeve and the satellite rotation.
read_strategy_macro_allocation: Macro allocation: the real advantage comes from an efficient structure over time.
read_strategy_pac_etf: ETF DCA: recurring frequency makes TER and per-order cost decisive.
read_strategy_session_breakout: Session breakout: execution quality and spread decide efficiency immediately.
read_strategy_mean_reversion_fx: FX mean reversion: spread and financing can erase the statistical edge.
read_strategy_macro_swing: Macro swing: carry stops being marginal.
read_strategy_carry_trade: Carry trade: funding is part of the result, not a side detail.
read_strategy_trend_day: Trend day: spread, slippage, and rollover define real cost.
read_strategy_open_drive: Open drive: the first minutes magnify every execution mistake.
read_strategy_breakout_pullback: Breakout pullback: execution and holding balance each other more than expected.
read_strategy_macro_trend: Macro trend: holding matters more than the entry trigger.
read_capital_small: Compact capital: fixed and recurring costs can distort the profile heavily.
read_capital_mid: Mid-size capital: it is worth comparing structure by instrument and broker.
read_capital_large: Large capital: percentage drag becomes more visible than the ticket.
read_leverage_unlevered: 1x leverage: the profile stays close to the direct instrument.
read_leverage_light: Moderate leverage: funding and wrapper choice start to matter.
read_leverage_high: High leverage: holding cost can dominate the final ranking.
preview_note: Qualitative indicator based on the selected combination. Full TradeScope applies broker tariffs and returns the final ranking.
